name: Social Savvy
description:
You have honed your techniques to be most effective within a certain social stratum. Choose a Keeping from among Wretched, Modest, Comfortable, Prosperous, and Opulent. Whenever you target a humanoid creature of that Keeping with a Mesmer ability, your rolls for that ability are favored.

However, your specialized approach draws skepticism from another social stratum. Choose another Keeping. Whenever you target a humanoid creature of that Keeping with a Mesmer ability, your rolls for that ability are ill-favored.

Describe your social connections.
